Dream 2026-11-22 suggests a refinement: broaden.

**What the vignettes add.** The need moves from per-record readability to a human-readable view of change across the repository, tied to merging. 07833bd2: 'We need to be able to present a useful view of what has changed.' 40f77b44: the remedy is 'a clear human readable diff of what has actually changed'. 5a95b823: 'A human needs to be able to see what has changed, and there has to be a realistic way to review how to merge.'

**Proposed.** A person cannot see what has actually changed in a record or a repository, so they cannot review it or decide how to merge it. Review of meaning degrades to trust.

**Depth.** Three vignettes on 2026-10-29 (one day, following one another); all retell the same need and name the same remedy. Recurrence over time is still thin.

If you agree, the change is made by succession: a successor that supersedes this record, which stays as it is.
